sace mayaṃ imāhi āpattīhi aññam'aññaṃ kāressāma, siyā'pi taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ kakkhaḷattāya vāḷattāya bhedāya saṃvatteyya.
sārambhe ce bhikkhu vatthusmiṃ aparikkamane saññācikāya kuṭiṃ kāreyya, bhikkhū vā anabhineyya vatthudesanāya, pamāṇaṃ vā atikkāmeyya, saṅgh'ādiseso.
santi kho pana, bhante, imasmiṃ rājakule khattiyakaññā'pi brāhmaṇakaññā'pi gahapatikaññā'pi, tās'āhaṃ issar'ādhipaccaṃ kāremi.

21387.meaning1: to cause to do; to cause to make
21387.meaning2: to cause to do; to cause to make

examples.text: atha kho bhagavato rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi, sakkā nu kho rajjaṃ kāretuṃ ahanaṃ aghātayaṃ ajinaṃ ajāpayaṃ asocaṃ asocāpayaṃ dhammenā'ti?

21388.meaning1: having made do; having caused to do

examples.text: te sādhū'ti paṭissutvā taṃ purisaṃ daḷhāya rajjuyā pacchābāhaṃ gāḷhabandhanaṃ bandhitvā khuramuṇḍaṃ kāretvā kharassarena paṇavena rathikāya rathikaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ parinetvā dakkhiṇena dvārena nikkhamitvā dakkhiṇato nagarassa āghātane nisīdāpeyyuṃ.
divāṭṭhāne nisinnakāle pana okāsaṃ kāretvā'va pucchantassa kathetabbo, akāretvā pucchantassa na kathetabbo. idaṃ vattaṃ ajānitvā pucchanto paṭipadāya na saṇṭhāti nāma.

21389.meaning2: having caused to build or construct

21390.meaning1: causing to do; causing to make
21390.meaning2: should be caused to do, build or construct

examples.text: atīte bārāṇasiyaṃ brahmadatte rajjaṃ kārente bodhisatto kāsigāmake kumbhakārakule nibbattitvā kumbhakārakammaṃ katvā puttadāraṃ posesi.

21391.meaning1: caused to do; caused to build
21391.meaning2: caused to do, build or construct

examples.text: seṭṭhi, sace me dhītā vijāyissati, tāya naṃ saddhiṃ nivesetvā seṭṭhiṭṭhānassa sāmikaṃ karissāmi. sace me putto vijāyissati, māressāmi nan'ti cintetvā taṃ gehe kāresi.
cattāro'me, bhikkhave, kālā sammā bhāviyamānā sammā anuparivattiyamānā anupubbena āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpenti

sādhu, devo, vāhanāgāresu ca dvāresu ca āṇāpetu, yena vāhanena jīvako icchati tena vāhanena gacchatu, yena dvārena icchati tena dvārena gacchatu, yaṃ kālaṃ icchati taṃ kālaṃ gacchatu, yaṃ kālaṃ icchati taṃ kālaṃ pavisatū'ti.

21393.meaning1: suitable time; appropriate occasion; right time

examples.text: yasmiñ'ca kho, bhikkhave, samaye līnaṃ cittaṃ hoti, kālo tasmiṃ samaye dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya, kālo vīriyasambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya, kālo pītisambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya.
kālavādī bhūtavādī atthavādī dhammavādī vinayavādī nidhānavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti kālena sāpadesaṃ pariyantavatiṃ atthasaṃhitaṃ
ākhyāta-sāgaram'ath'ajjatanī-taraṅ'gaṃ, dhātujjalaṃ vikaraṇ'āgamakālamīnaṃ, lop'ānubandh'ariyam'attha-vibhāga-tīraṃ, dhīrā taranti kavino puthubuddhināvā.
sare'ty'asmiṃ opasilesiko kāsasattamī, tato vaṇṇakālabyavadhāne kāriyaṃ na hoti.
kālaṃ vo'haṃ na jānāmi, channo kālo na dissati, tasmā abhutvā bhikkhāmi, mā maṃ kālo upaccagā'ti.
sato, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sampajāno kālaṃ āgameyya. ayaṃ vo amhākaṃ anusāsanī.

21397.commentary: (SNa) aparajju vā kāle'ti dutiyadivase vā bhikkhācārakāle. vihāragaruko kir'esa thero.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā nigrodhakappo pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto vihāraṃ pavisati, sāyaṃ vā nikkhamati aparajju vā kāle
kālapabb'aṅgasaṅkāso, kiso dhamanisanthato, mattaññū annapānamhi, adīnamanaso naro.
seyyathā'pi, bho gotama, ye keci mūlagandhā, kāl'ānusāri tesaṃ aggam'akkhāyati… evam'eva bhoto gotamassa ovādo param'ajjadhammesu.
